title: Jazzy Malaysian Fish Curry
description: A briny, velvety fish curry that blends dark brown sugar, shio cure, and aromatic spices into a crowd-pleasing, egg-free-friendly dish.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with shio cure salt and let them sit for 15 minutes to lightly cure.
Pat the fillets dry with paper towels and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan over medium heat.
Add the red curry paste to the pan and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the dark brown sugar, fish sauce, tamarind paste, and lime juice, and simmer for 3 minutes to marry the flavors.
Carefully slide the fish fillets into the curry, cover, and cook for 5 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Remove the pan from heat and scatter the fresh coriander leaves over the curry.
Serve the curry over steamed jasmine rice, optionally drizzling a little coconut cream for extra velvety richness.
